# AudioPad - LLM Access Information

- **Website**: https://audiopad.vercel.app
- **GitHub**: https://github.com/audiopadapp/audiopad/

## What is AudioPad?
AudioPad is a free, open-source soundboard application for Windows and Linux that plays audio files through your microphone with sub-20ms low latency, customizable global hotkeys, and zero telemetry or accounts.

## Key Features
- Free & open-source (GNU GPLv3 License)
- Native packages for Windows 10/11 (.exe) and Linux (.deb, .rpm, .AppImage)
- Dual output stream routing (headphone monitoring + virtual mic injection)
- VB-Cable virtual audio device automated onboarding & detection
- Interactive transport dock with real-time scrubber and playback controls
- Customizable sound cards with image background art
- Drag-and-drop audio library management with batch assignment
- Global hotkeys for instant playback in full-screen games
- Sub-20ms low-latency C++ audio playback engine
- Zero telemetry, no user accounts, no cloud sync, no advertisements
- Seamless integration with Discord, Zoom, Microsoft Teams, OBS, and games
